title: Powered Door Skip
instructions:
By doing a Standing Reverse Baron Jump from atop the powered cube pillar you can land on the adjacent wall and skip waiting for the door lowering animation.

Second video shows a method of using a regular Baron Jump from atop the Minecart station to land on the same wall, from Gardenia's POV.
